name: stone-landing
note: A block of stone of tens of tons that lands on a floor of stone after a fall from a high wall. The accepted hit on the wall (wall-hit), without the engine's room, two octaves lower, its first 15 ms one octave lower, its body ending in 0.5 s, a soft limit of drive 2.5, and the hall after it. The owner accepted it on 2026-11-10 as the variant loud of module-2.json ("it looks right"), with the first landing 9 dB over the hit on the wall.
